title: Real flavour text on cards
detail: Find and add REAL flavour text (lore/atmosphere) to the card detail dataset (`src/data/cards.json`). The current data has rules `effect` text but excludes flavour. Source it and add a `flavour` field per card so the app — and the game story generator — can draw on it.
remaining: Cards carry unofficial atmosphere lines (flavour_unofficial). Official card flavour still to source and add as a `flavour` field.

title: Update card detail for the extra data
detail: The card dataset has richer fields (tags, range/damage/hands, bonus_health, epic flags, start_health/horror, etc.). Surface the useful ones in the places that show card detail (CardPicker, Game Log detail, Codex if relevant).
remaining: cardData.js exposes the extra fields, but the CardPicker (and Game Log detail) do not show them yet.

title: Richer game summary using the extra card detail
detail: Feed the extra card-detail JSON (effects, flavour, tags) into the game story generator (`src/lib/narrateGame.js`) so recaps describe what cards actually did, not just name them. Pairs naturally with the Tier 2 AI recap.

title: Rich-data trends in MI / Stats (embellished with card detail)
detail:
Surface the captured rich data as trends in the MI/Stats tab, and embellish them using the card dataset (effects, flavour, tags) so the stats read like insight, not just counts. Ideas:
- Most-found and most-used items (by name); your "signature" item.
- Win rate when the Epic Dark Power / Finale came out vs not.
- Average turn the first Dark Power lands; average turn the Finale opens.
- Average victims saved vs died, and how that correlates with winning.
- Which Events/Terror cards show up most in your losses ("your nemesis cards").
- Turn you typically enable your Final Girl Ultimate, and win rate once enabled.
- Pull card flavour/effect into the trend captions for colour (e.g. show the item's flavour line next to "most-used item").
- Feed these aggregates to the (future) Tier 2 AI for a "meta" season summary.

title: AI game recap (Tier 2 — richer narrative via an LLM)
detail:
Tier 1 (offline template recap) is DONE and shipped. Tier 2 would send the structured game to a real LLM for a creative, interpretive narrative. Design notes for when we build it:
- Static site on public GitHub Pages — no backend. A billing API key must NOT be baked into the frontend (view-source would leak it).
- Recommended (single user): a Settings box where you paste your own LLM API key, stored only in `localStorage` (never committed, never synced). An "AI recap" button sends the game to the provider and caches the result.
- Providers: Google Gemini (free tier), OpenAI, Anthropic — keep swappable.
- Alternative: a serverless proxy (Cloudflare/Vercel) holding the key — overkill for one user.

title: Card dropdowns when editing a saved game
detail: When you open a saved game in the Game Log and press Edit, the items, events, dark powers etc. are plain text boxes, so you have to type card names from memory. During live play you get a pick-from-the-list dropdown of the real cards instead. Add those same dropdowns to the Edit screen.

title: Voice: better narrator + read the game story aloud
detail:
Two related voice improvements:
1. Improve the start-of-game narration voice (the current Web Speech / system voice sounds poor — "crap voice"). Pick a better voice, tune rate/pitch, or move to a nicer TTS. Relevant code: src/hooks/useNarration.js.
2. NEW: after a game is saved, let the voice read the generated story narrative aloud — a "read me the recap" button on the Game Log detail (and/or an auto-offer right after Save result). Reuse the narrateGame output as the text to speak. Note: if the Tier 2 AI recap lands, prefer speaking that richer text. A nicer cloud TTS would also pair with the user-supplied-API-key approach noted above.

title: Extreme Horror Mode dice track
detail: The Turn Tracker now computes Horror Roll dice from the STANDARD player board track (Horror 1 = 3 dice, 2–5 = 2 dice, 6 = 1 die). Extreme Horror mode uses a harsher track (and 5 Time per turn instead of 6). Add an Extreme-mode toggle and its dice mapping so the dice count is right in that mode too. Relevant code: diceForHorror() in src/views/TurnTracker.jsx.
remaining: Extreme toggle (Setup Assist step 3 and the Turn Tracker) and 5 Time per turn are built. Still to do: the dice for each Horror level on the Extreme side of the player board — read them off the board and add an EXTREME_DICE table to TurnTracker.jsx (the tracker says "see board" until then).
